This section offers a comprehensive guide to the various types of scholarships available across all programs at JKLU, including merit-based awards and others designed for specific needs.
Scholarships are available for B.Tech applicants based on their Class 12 percentage, JEE Mains exam results, or CUET scores.
*B. Tech 12th Standard Subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and English
**B. Tech CUET Subjects: English, Mathematics, and one domain-specific subject

Candidates who have scored between 50 and 55 in Math will receive a scholarship one level lower than originally qualified for. For example, if such a candidate is eligible for a 75% scholarship based on 12th marks/JEE Main/CUET score, they will receive a 50% scholarship instead.
The candidates who passed their XII in the year 2025 or the year 2026 will only be eligible for scholarships.
All the other criteria for scholarships shall remain same.
Scholarships for BBA applicants are awarded based on merit, specifically through Class 12 results or CUET scores.
*BBA 12th Standard: English and any three additional subjects (internals with weightage more than 50% to not be considered)
**BBA CUET Score: English and two domain-specific subjects of choice
Candidates must have a minimum of 55% aggregate marks in Class XII, including English and three subjects of the applicant's choice.
The courses such as Physical Education, Information Practices, and such may be considered for eligibility. The decision of the admission committee shall be final in this regard.
Applicants will be awarded scholarships through 12th score or performance in JK-DET and portfolio round.
*Specified subjects include English and three subjects chosen by the applicant. However, a subject with internal marks of 50 percent or higher will not be considered.
Students who achieve a 90 percentile or higher in the JK-DET and score 4 or more in the portfolio review are eligible for a 50% scholarship.
Students who meet only one of the above criteria (either >=90 percentile in JK-DET or achieving 4 or more in the portfolio round) will be eligible for a 25% scholarship.
Students are not permitted to combine scholarships from JK-DET and Class 12 scores; only one scholarship can be availed.

Applicants who do not qualify for a scholarship through the JKDET but surpass a predetermined cutoff in the NID, NIFT, or UCEED entrance exams will be granted a 25% scholarship on the academic fee. The specific cutoffs for these exams are yet to be determined.
Note that only one scholarship will apply, based on the highest achievement in either the JKDET, NID, NIFT, or UCEED entrance exams. Scholarships from multiple sources cannot be combined.
A 20% scholarship will be awarded to applicants who are siblings of JKLU students or alumni, or alumni pursuing a second degree.
All Single girl children with no siblings will be eligible for a 10% scholarship.

A 10% scholarship will be awarded to applicants who are wards of defense personnel, SC/ST, differently abled students, students from Northeast, Union Territories (except Delhi and Chandigarh) and students from JKO school
A special committee will evaluate and award scholarships on a case-by-case basis to applicants demonstrating exceptional performance in sports or other areas.

A 15% scholarship will be granted to the wards of JKLU staff and employees of JK Organization entities. In the case of wards of JK Organization employees, the scholarship amount will be reimbursed to the employee by their respective JK Organization company/entity.
If a student qualifies for more than one scholarship, only the higher value scholarship will be applied.
A 20% discount is available for siblings of alumni who have graduated from JKLU with a full-time degree. This discount applies only to new enrollments, not to siblings already enrolled
Scholarships apply solely to academic fees.

At JK Lakshmipat University, we believe that financial constraints should not come in the way of a student’s plan to pursue higher education. Apart from scholarships, the university provides financial assistance to students by facilitating applications for educational loans from external financial organizations. Our collaborations with these organizations cater to the needs of the students by helping them obtain loans at an attractive rate in a hassle-free manner.
The Disciplinary Committee and the Unfair Means Committee have the authority to alter or terminate scholarships based on violations of academic or disciplinary standard.
The consequences of such breaches are as follows:
First Offense: Reduction of scholarship to the next lower percentage level.
Second Offense: Complete revocation of the scholarship.

These committees have the discretion to either maintain the scholarship in cases of minor infractions or remove it entirely on a first serious offense. This policy ensures that scholarships are awarded in a manner that upholds the integrity and standards of JK Lakshmipat University.
